narrative:
Licking County has 125,971 registered voters, with 55.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 29.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 15.1%, a pronounced Republican lean of 14.0 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.0% of registrants.
